first.rationale: Competitor entry pricing creates an immediate acquisition threat among price-sensitive SMBs, and pricing is the most directly relevant prior direction. Because the objective is sustainable qualified revenue rather than short-term signups, the acquisition and revenue-quality evidence behind pricing must be verified before committing. Onboarding is also verified because its current decline may offer a durable alternative lever and prior evidence is highly relevant to the simultaneous completion decline. A guarded pricing test limits discount anchoring, margin erosion, and low-quality acquisition risk.

final.rationale: Run a standard experiment shortening onboarding. It directly addresses the 4% completion decline and has verified evidence of higher completion, 2.1-day faster time-to-value, and improved 30-day retention, making it the strongest available route to sustainable qualified revenue. Do not use promotional pricing: verification showed its apparently strong acquisition and qualified-revenue lift came with a 12% 30-day retention decline and was explicitly unsuitable for sustainable growth. Guard against removing information needed for qualification or implementation by monitoring downstream account quality and retention by cohort.
